      <div class='meta'>
        <div class='list-title mathjax'><span class='descriptor'>Title:</span>
          Horizon-LM: A RAM-Centric Architecture for LLM Training
        </div>
        <div class='list-authors'><a href="https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&amp;query=Yuan,+Z">Zhengqing Yuan</a>, <a href="https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&amp;query=Sun,+L">Lichao Sun</a>, <a href="https://arxiv.org/search/cs?searchtype=author&amp;query=Ye,+Y">Yanfang Ye</a></div>

        <div class='list-comments mathjax'><span class='descriptor'>Comments:</span>
          This paper contained an error in the throughput computation used in the experimental evaluation. Specifically, the TFLOPS calculation omitted the 12HL term in the training FLOPs formula, which led to systematic underestimation of the reported throughput numbers in the experimental results. We are withdrawing this version to correct the evaluation and avoid confusion for readers
        </div>
